workstreams.title: Staff and battle rhythm
completion_criteria: Integrate chair/quorum, packet completeness, deadlines, and human disposition without auto-execution.

workstreams.title: COP and reporting
completion_criteria: Project current mission state with freshness and role filtering; preserve critical reporting while limiting noise.

workstreams.title: Intent and disciplined initiative
completion_criteria: Preserve parent intent, tasks, and authority bounds across delegation and method deviations.

workstreams.title: Force, readiness, and partner boundaries
completion_criteria: Reconcile task organization, training/readiness changes, authority ceilings, and partner/liaison boundaries.

workstreams.title: Resource and sustainment operations
completion_criteria: Validate resource priority, starvation handling, checkpoints, and recovery with retained approval for changed risk.

workstreams.title: Controlled context and release outputs
completion_criteria: Validate classification, exceptions, audience, approvals, expiry, and revocation before boundary crossing.

workstreams.title: Knowledge and handoff
completion_criteria: Resolve authoritative records, verify handoff triggers and acceptance, and maintain source-bound indexes.

workstreams.title: Dry-run approval UI
completion_criteria: Present real bounded decision dispositions and consume approvals with stale/conflict protection.
